title: A whole lotta extra work just to boil eggs.
text:
A whole lotta extra work just to boil eggs.. This little gadget made pretty good eggs and was simple to set up and use. It's small and takes up very little counter/cupboard space and really is a cute color. I could see how this would be valuable if you had no stove top. The directions are easy to follow and the unit is easy to use. You need to fill up water with included cup according to how you'd like your eggs cooked (medium, hard, poached). There are marks on side of cup. Pour that water onto base, insert rack, add eggs (you will also need to poke a hole on top of egg before cooking. See picture of included tool to use) then, cover unit and turn on. The unit will chime rather loudly until it's turned off. My hard boiled eggs took 15 minutes. They were not fully cooked thru, as you can still see some soft yolks in pix. They were easy to peel and tasted great. Next, I tried the poached egg setting. It took 4 minutes and it was softly poached with yolks still runny. It has to cook in an included plastic bowl. That's a pain to clean up and the egg stuck to it. The heating element turned brown with water marks after cooking. The directions suggest to clean this white vinegar.
I gave this 3 stars because even though the unit works exactly as stated, it's a pain to have to poke a hole on the top of your egg. And it's a pain to have to scrub little bowl out after poaching. And it's a pain to pull out white vinegar and clean surfaces. I got this thinking my kid's would be able to use it w/o me. There is NO WAY I'd let them use it unsupervised. Not just the poking the top of the egg part, but the fact that it does not automatically turn off after a certain amount of time. Freaks me out that they'd leave it on and burn the house down, even with the chime.
And honestly, it just is a whole lot of extra steps simply to hard boil an egg.
To do that, all you have to do is pull out a small pan, fill a few inches with water and bring to boil. Add eggs, cover, turn off heat and set timer for 10 minutes. Now there is just 1 pan to clean. And your eggs are cooked thru perfectly and easy to peel.

features: One-touch cooking: simply fill up the measuring cup to your desired water level, choosing between soft, medium or hard boiled, turn it on and within minutes the alarm will let you know that breakfast is served!
7-Egg capacity: egg tray allows you to cook up to 7 eggs at a time, delivering healthy, consistent results the way you like it

Egg-celent recipes: this egg cooker can make a variety of eggs such as soft, medium or hard-boiled eggs, egg whites, poached eggs, scrambled eggs, omelets, various salads, deviled eggs, egg sandwiches - and can even be used to steam vegetables and dumplings! The perfect dish for any breakfast, dinner party or special event
Cool-touch handles: keep your Hands safe with the cool-touch handles, allowing you to open and close the lid without burning yourself
Included: measuring cup with egg piercing tip, 7-egg tray, egg poacher/scrambled egg bowl, egg white separator are all included
Easy-to-clean: egg tray and stainless-steel steam cooking plate are detachable, as well as the accessories, making clean up a breeze
Compact design: Its sleek, small design makes it a must have for smaller kitchens, dorms, apartments and campers/RVs!
Egg size: best used with large or smaller-sized eggs
description: Now you can cook the perfect healthy egg every time with this stylish premium Nostalgia 7-egg cooker! Have to deal busy schedules or picky eaters? No problem! This cooker can make hard boiled eggs, poached eggs, scrambled eggs, various salads and more - and can even be used to steam vegetables and make dumplings! With a touch of a button, cooking eggs has never been easier - just add your desired water and the alarm will sound once the eggs are done. All parts are detachable, making it easy to clean. This is the best way to prepare quick, healthy breakfasts!
